class.name: RuntimeVirtualTexture
class.brief_description: A sparse, streamed texture that caches a top-down render of the scene.
class.description: A runtime virtual texture (RVT) renders the geometry inside a [RuntimeVirtualTextureVolume] from above into a pool of fixed size pages, and only keeps the pages that cameras currently need. Materials can then sample the result with [method apply_to_material] and a world position, which is useful for terrain blending, road and decal layers, or any effect that needs a cheap top-down snapshot of the scene. Meshes contribute to the texture when their [member VisualInstance3D.layers] intersect [member cull_mask]. The contribution is the albedo (and, depending on [member material_type], normal, roughness, metallic or height) the mesh material outputs. Moving, showing, hiding or changing the layers of a mesh refreshes the affected pages automatically. Changes to material parameters are not tracked, call [method invalidate] after changing them. Pages are requested from the cameras that rendered the scene during the previous frame and at most [member max_pages_per_frame] pages are rendered per frame. Pages that are not resident yet fall back to the closest lower resolution page that is. [b]Note:[/b] Only the Forward+ and Mobile renderers support runtime virtual textures.

method.name: apply_to_material
method.description: Writes the uniforms that the RVT shader include expects into [param material]: [code]{prefix}_page_table[/code], [code]{prefix}_physical0[/code], [code]{prefix}_physical1[/code], [code]{prefix}_params0[/code], [code]{prefix}_params1[/code], [code]{prefix}_world_to_uv[/code], [code]{prefix}_normal_basis[/code], [code]{prefix}_debug_mode[/code] and [code]{prefix}_debug_force_lod[/code]. The material keeps being updated when the volume moves or the debug settings change.

method.name: bake_height_grid_file
method.description: Bakes signed single-channel floating-point heights on a vertex grid. Texel zero coincides with vertex zero at every mip. Each page includes its neighbors in the border for interpolation across page boundaries.

method.name: bake_page_file
method.description: Bakes [param image] into a page file that [member source] = [constant SOURCE_STREAM] can stream. The virtual texture is [code]2 ^ log2_tile_count * tile_size[/code] texels wide; every page carries [param tile_border] texels of edge clamped neighbours so bilinear filtering works across page edges. [constant FORMAT_BC1] and [constant FORMAT_BC7] require the tile size and border to be multiples of 4. Returns [constant OK] on success.

method.name: get_layer_count
method.description: Returns the number of physical texture layers used by the current [member material_type] and [member source].

method.name: get_page_info
method.description: Returns the state of one page: [code]exists[/code], [code]resident[/code], [code]dirty[/code], [code]blocked[/code], [code]pool_x[/code], [code]pool_y[/code], [code]in_flight[/code], [code]locked[/code] and [code]lock_seconds_left[/code].

method.name: get_page_table_texture
method.description: Returns the indirection texture that maps virtual pages to physical pages. It has one mipmap per virtual texture level and must be read with [code]texelFetch[/code].

method.name: get_physical_texture
method.description: Returns the physical page pool texture of the given [param layer].

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns debugging statistics: [code]resident_pages[/code], [code]pool_pages[/code], [code]requested_pages[/code], [code]rendered_this_frame[/code], [code]rendered_total[/code], [code]evicted_total[/code], [code]gpu_ready[/code], [code]streaming[/code] and [code]levels[/code] (resident pages per level).

method.name: invalidate
method.description: Marks all pages overlapping [param world_aabb] as stale so they are rendered (or re-read) again.

method.name: invalidate_all
method.description: Marks all pages as stale so they are rendered (or re-read) again.

method.name: lock_page
method.description: Keeps the page produced and resident for [param seconds], even when it is off screen, and refreshes it every frame (mirrors UE's pick + refresh debug). At most 6 pages can be locked; locking a seventh releases the one expiring first.

method.name: pick_page
method.description: Maps a world position to the page covering it at [param level], returned as [code]Vector3i(level, x, y)[/code]. Pair with [method get_page_info] and [method lock_page].

method.name: unlock_page
method.description: Releases a page locked with [method lock_page].

members.member: Only [VisualInstance3D]s whose layers intersect this mask are rendered into the texture.
Pins the sampled mip level to this value. [code]-1[/code] uses the level computed from the camera distance.

Replaces the sampled color with a debug visualization: page table, residency per level, physical pool tiles, LOD heat map or page borders. Requires the receiver material to call the RVT shader include.
If [code]false[/code], no new pages are produced. Pages that are already resident keep being sampled.
Bias added to the mip level selected from the camera distance. Positive values use lower resolution pages.
Base 2 logarithm of the number of pages along one side of the virtual texture. The virtual texture is [code]2 ^ log2_tile_count * tile_size[/code] texels wide. A page file overrides this value.
What is stored in the texture when [member source] is [constant SOURCE_RENDER].
Maximum number of pages rendered (or loaded) per frame.
Page file to stream when [member source] is [constant SOURCE_STREAM]. Setting it switches [member source] to [constant SOURCE_STREAM] and adopts the layout stored in the file.
Number of physical pages along one side of the page pool. The pool holds [code]pool_size * pool_size[/code] pages. When it is too small, the finest pages are dropped first.
Where page contents come from: rendered from the scene every frame, or streamed from [member page_file].
Border in texels added around each page so bilinear filtering works across page edges. A page file overrides this value.
Size of one page in texels, without border. A page file overrides this value.

constants.constant: Stores albedo in the first layer (sRGB encoded, alpha holds coverage).
Stores albedo in the first layer and normal (x and z of the volume local normal), roughness and metallic in the second layer.
Stores the height inside the volume, normalized to [code]0..1[/code], in a single float layer.
Pages are rendered from the scene every frame (runtime virtual texture).
Pages are streamed from a baked page file (streaming virtual texture).
BC1 compressed tiles, 8 bytes per 4x4 block. No alpha.
BC7 compressed tiles, 16 bytes per 4x4 block.
Single precision float tiles, used by [constant MATERIAL_WORLD_HEIGHT].
Colors every page by the physical pool tile it resolves to; coarser fallbacks are darker, invalid pages are magenta, page edges are white.
Colors every page by the level it actually resolves to (one color per level), which shows fallbacks directly.
Colors pages by their pool tile and draws the per tile border band in green.
Heat map of the LOD used for sampling: blue is level 0, red is the coarsest level.
Draws the page grid in red and the tile border ring in green over a dark background.
